name: CKEditor5 Wiris (MathType/ChemType)
description: Add ability to insert math and chemistry equations — using MathType and ChemType — into your CKEditor5.
project_description:
This module integrates WIRIS Editor into CKEditor. WIRIS is the leading equation editor for web-based platforms. It adds ability to insert math and chemistry equations — using MathType and ChemType — into your CKEditor.

 WIRIS Editor generates the equation using MathML , but it doesn't handle the rendering. In order to view the formula in your content, you must use a rendering solution such as MathJax .

 
 Licensing 
 While this module is totally free and Open Source, the software and services provided by Wiris are not. A valid license is needed in order to use this module. More info can be found on their website: https://www.wiris.com/en/mathtype/ or contact them through sales@wiris.com .

 
 Back to top 

 Versions 
 3.0.x 
 Supports only CkEditor 5. Drupal 10 & 11 support.

 2.x 
 Supports only CkEditor 4. Drupal 9 & 10 support.

 7.x-1.x 
 Supports only CkEditor 4. Drupal 7 support.

 Installation 
 
 Install the module as usual 
 Go to Text formats and editors (admin/config/content/formats), add the MathType and ChemType into your editor 
 Back to top
